BASE=$(.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main) || BASE=main
if CREATE_OUT=$(gh pr create --base "$BASE" --draft --title "meta: incomplete-edit — widen the coverage-universal detector noun set" --body-file .prflow/tmp/pr-body-1451.md 2>&1); then
  printf '%s\ncreate: ok\n' "$CREATE_OUT"

ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
mkdir -p "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp"
[ -n "${ZSH_VERSION:-}" ] && setopt nonomatch || :
set -- "$ROOT"/.prflow/tmp/review/*/*/iter-*.json
{ [ -e "$1" ] && printf '%s\n' "$@" | sort; } | tee "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before" > /dev/null || :
echo "snapshot done"; wc -l "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before"

ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
mkdir -p "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp"
find "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/review" -name 'iter-*.json' 2>/dev/null | sort | tee "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before"

PR_STATE=$(.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .prflow_implement.implement_pr_state ready_for_review) || PR_STATE=ready_for_review
echo "PR_STATE=[$PR_STATE]"
if [ "$PR_STATE" = "draft" ]; then
  echo "OUTCOME=draft"
elif gh pr ready 1502; then
  echo "OUTCOME=published"
elif [ "$(gh pr view 1502 --json isDraft --jq '.isDraft' 2>/dev/null)" = "false" ]; then
  echo "OUTCOME=published_idempotent"
else
  echo "OUTCOME=publish_failed"
fi

TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/run-jq.sh -r '.comment.id // empty' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true)

fi
